name: v126_factual_service_overrun_contract
source: v121 immutable 285 selected roots and 57 original packets per scenario; qualified v120 replay and v124 passive receiver interface

target.observed: Use only departure observed within original [issue,issue+60] evidence.
target.censored: If D is absent, continuous original observation reaches E=issue+60, and B<=E, Y=1 is identified. Otherwise Y remains unknown. Preserve original departure-time censoring.
target.release: Original packet_deadline strictly less than next issue_time. Original 60-second window and 30-second delay remain; no early release at D or B.

inputs.n: receiver.current_leg_dest_count, only if current_stage0_complete; complete n=0 remains valid
inputs.excluded: Future exchange/departure, estimated service-ready age and onboard IDs are not model features.

estimator.intercept: unpenalized; both classes required in common-prefix initialization
estimator.transform: Fixed log1p(n), h/60; no learned scaling or clipping.
estimator.fit: Deterministic convex optimization from zero coefficients, at most100 Newton iterations, max absolute gradient <=1e-8; numerical nonconvergence is HOLD, no replacement solver or penalty tuning within candidate.

initialization: 135 identical shared roots with original packet_deadline<=9000, counted once. Fit one n+h model and one h-only model once; share each initialization across the two suffixes. Initialize frozen n+h as a copy.

evaluation.roots: Only the 150 roots strictly after9000 in each scenario; 300 suffix slots total. No prefix root contributes to formal Brier.
evaluation.schedule: Sort by (window_start, sequence), release only own-scene packets with deadline<issue. Predict before exposing the current target. Expand eligible history without resampling. Refit once per nonempty released packet needed by a later prediction, not after the last prediction.
evaluation.frozen: Shared-prefix n+h logistic model, no feedback updates.
evaluation.fresh: Same initial n+h model, fixed expanding refits using own original mature packets.
evaluation.hold_only: Same causal schedule, objective and initialization roots with bn absent; isolates n information.
evaluation.past_prevalence: Beta(1,1) posterior mean (positive_count+1)/(label_count+2), same released eligible labels.
evaluation.clock_zero_risk: p=0 for Y=1[D>ceil(applied_at+h)], equivalent to predicting no departure beyond the deterministic command clock.

missingness: Attempt every fixed slot; keep unknown inputs/targets in place and report separately, no zero imputation or replacement roots. Missing any required prefix or suffix value means descriptive eligible-pair scores only and HOLD of the primary factual gate. No fitting if prefix lacks either class.
metrics: Per-scenario unweighted paired Brier mean((p-Y)**2) on the original suffix proportions, fresh-minus-each-comparator, counts, and classwise Brier decomposition. No accuracy or post-hoc thresholds as admission metrics.
factual_gate: Complete declared coverage, both prefix classes, valid causal chronology and converged fits. Fresh Brier <= frozen, hold_only, past_prevalence and clock_zero_risk separately in both scenarios; strictly < frozen in at least one scenario AND strictly < hold_only in at least one scenario. Direct arithmetic signs without performance tolerance. Failure closes this fixed estimator; no window, class, feature or threshold sweep.
later_passive_collection: NEW dataset view for all285 roots/scenario using original recorded commands through each maximum selected-root clock. Stop before applying the last root. Retain full logs and root manifest on server. Reuse unchanged original60-second labels only after qualified prefix/action agreement. No fitting during field collection.
cost_gate: Complete four days and technical checks. fresh-minus-matched-no_fresh mean<0,stable<=0,shock<0; additionally fresh-minus-same-actor-frozen<=0 in each scenario and at least one<0. Report no_fresh-minus-frozen to distinguish baseline drift. Early and tail windows are descriptive, not new gates.
interpretation: Existing two suffixes share one initialization and external seed; this is an exposed-data factual prediction study, not independent confirmation, causal action-response identification or control benefit. v122 closed calibration conclusion remains unchanged.
transfer: Only metadata receipt <=6000 bytes for this step; no raw rows, CSV or checkpoints downloaded.
